description: On the two-element structure with \(E(a,b)\leftrightarrow a\ne b\), the capture-free instance \(\exists z\,E(y,z)\) is true at every value of the free variable, whereas \(\exists y\,E(y,y)\) is false.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.DefinitionalExtensions.capture_counterexample :
  (∀ (v : Unit → Bool), (Lemmatheca.Entry.DefinitionalExtensions.captureCorrect { down := ⋯ }).Realize v) ∧
    ∀ (v : Unit → Bool), ¬(Lemmatheca.Entry.DefinitionalExtensions.captureWrong { down := ⋯ }).Realize v
